cases.case_label: Antisense AluYb8 c.143_144ins in exon 2 of MEN1
cases.mechanism_detail: An AluYb8 inserted in inverted (antisense) orientation within MEN1 exon 2 at p.Leu48 (16-bp TSD, ~44-nt polyA) introduces a premature stop codon, predicted to cause NMD or a truncated protein retaining ~8% of MEN1; it disrupted the MLPA probe site, mimicking an exon 2 deletion, and cosegregated with MEN1 in two families.
cases.quote: In silico analysis revealed that the MEN1:c.143_144insAlu leads to the premature appearance of a stop codon in the MEN1 gene.
